:::{#exm-proposition}
#### Propositions, and a sentence that is not one

- "$2 + 3 = 5$" is a proposition, and it is true.
- "$7$ is [even](number-systems.qmd#def-even-odd)" is a proposition, and it is false.
- "$x > 2$" is not a proposition on its own:
  it is true when $x = 3$ and false when $x = 1$,
  so it has no truth value until $x$ is given a value.

:::
